# cdfquant01reg

The cdfquant01reg package implements Bayesian regression with the
finite-tailed CDF-quantile (FTCDFQ) distributions (Smithson & Shou,
2024) and their extended-support versions in the BRMS package in R.

## Installation

Because this package relies on the high-performance `cmdstanr` backend
engine for compilation speed and Windows 11 stability, you must install
the Stan compiler toolchain before installing this package.

``` r

# 1. Install the compiler interface from the Stan repository
install.packages("cmdstanr", repos = c('https://r-universe.dev', getOption("repos")))

# 2. Download and configure the standalone C++ Stan compiler
cmdstanr::install_cmdstan(overwrite = TRUE)

# 3. Install cdfquant01reg from source (or GitHub)
# install.packages("path/to/cdfquant01reg_0.1.0.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type = "source")
```

## Quick Start Workflow

The package uses an interactive menu structure to manage its large
library of 48 custom distributions without cluttering your global
workspace. It has two families of distributions, the 32 two- and
three-parameter FTCDFQ distributions, and the 16 extended-support
distributions based on the two-parameter FTCDFQ distributions.

### 1. Load the Package

``` r

library(cdfquant01reg)
```

### 2. Choose a Distribution

Run either the standard or extended selection menu to pull up the
numbered listing. Enter the number corresponding to your chosen
distribution.

``` r

# For standard distributions (32 options)
select_ftcdfq()

# For extended distributions (16 options)
select_exftcdfq()
```

### 3. Fit Your Model

Once selected, the distribution parameters (`my_family` and `stanvars`)
are automatically mapped. You can fit your model using the wrapper
functions as in this example, which uses the yoon dataset:

``` r

myfit <- ftcdfq(
  formula = bf(pphysdecis ~ 1, sigma ~ 1), 
  data = yoon, 
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)

# Inspect the model estimates and associated statistics:
summary(myfit)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`blame`](https://msmithson975.github.io/cdfquant01reg/reference/blame.md)
  : Blame Data Set
- [`exftcdfq()`](https://msmithson975.github.io/cdfquant01reg/reference/exftcdfq.md)
  : Fit an EXFTCDFQ Model using brms
- [`ftcdfq()`](https://msmithson975.github.io/cdfquant01reg/reference/ftcdfq.md)
  : Fit an FTCDFQ Model using brms
- [`select_exftcdfq()`](https://msmithson975.github.io/cdfquant01reg/reference/select_exftcdfq.md)
  : Select an extended EXFTCDFQ distribution
- [`select_ftcdfq()`](https://msmithson975.github.io/cdfquant01reg/reference/select_ftcdfq.md)
  : Select a standard FTCDFQ distribution
- [`yoon`](https://msmithson975.github.io/cdfquant01reg/reference/yoon.md)
  : Yoon Data Set
